Holiday giveaway Ten pairs of tickets Enter by Dec 3
Winterlight · Friday, December 11, 2026

Ten pairs of tickets, free.

For this concert we are giving away twenty tickets, as ten pairs, to people who write and tell us they would like to come. There is nothing to buy and nothing to sign up for.

Enter the lottery →

How to enter.

  1. 1

    Send an email to info@creartbox.nyc

    From whatever address you want to be reached at.

  2. 2

    Put WINTERLIGHT LOTTERY in the subject line

    Those two words, so nothing gets lost in the inbox. Everything else is up to you.

  3. 3

    Tell us why you would like to come

    One sentence is enough. It is not a competition and nobody is marking it. We read them because we like reading them.

Enter the lottery →

If your email program does not open, write to info@creartbox.nyc yourself with the subject WINTERLIGHT LOTTERY.

What you can win
Two tickets to Winterlight. Ten people win.
Entries close
Wednesday, December 3, 2026, at midnight New York time.
The draw
Thursday, December 4, one week before the concert.
How you hear
By email, on December 4. Everyone who entered hears back, not only the ten who win.
The concert
Friday, December 11, 2026, 7:30 pm.
The DiMenna Center, 450 West 37th Street.
See the programme

Why we are doing this.

A concert ticket is a strange thing to ask someone to buy. You cannot try it first, and if you have never been to a chamber music concert you have no way of knowing whether you will like it until you have already paid to find out.

We would rather remove that. Free and subsidised tickets have been part of how this ensemble works for years, through NYC Culture Pass and the Queens Public Library. This is the same idea, said out loud, for one night.

Our tickets start at $15, which is low for New York and still not nothing. Twenty seats in a hall of this size is a real share of the room.

The small print.

What happens to my email address?

It is used to tell you the result of the lottery, and then it is deleted. We do not add you to anything. If you would like to hear from us about future concerts, write “add me to the newsletter” somewhere in your email and we will, and you can leave at any time. If you do not write it, we will not.

How many times can I enter?

Once. A second email from the same address does not improve the odds, and we would rather spend the evening listening than counting duplicates.

Do I have to live in New York?

No, but the tickets are for one night in Midtown Manhattan and we cannot help with getting there. Enter if you can come.

What if I win and cannot make it?

Tell us, and the pair goes to the next name out. An empty seat helps nobody.

How is the draw made?

At random, from everyone who wrote in by the deadline. What you write does not change your chances. We ask for a sentence because we would like to know who is coming, not to judge who deserves it.

Can I still buy a ticket?

Yes, and most people will. Tickets start at $15 through Eventbrite, and buying one is what pays the musicians who play that night. The concert page has them.
